title: roll credits
description: Got footage that needs a story, a brand that needs motion, or just a cursed meme to share? Pick the channel that fits and it lands in my inbox.

lanes.label: 01 / the edit
lanes.title: Need an editor on the project?
lanes.description: Brand films, music videos, YouTube channels, campaign cutdowns — I take on full post-production: edit, grade, sound, and delivery in every aspect ratio you need.

lanes.label: 02 / the motion
lanes.title: Want it to move?
lanes.description: Logo stings, kinetic type, explainer graphics, title sequences, and reusable motion toolkits your team can keep shipping with after I hand off.

lanes.label: 03 / the banter
lanes.title: Just want to talk frames?
lanes.description: Reference swaps, edit breakdowns, gaming montage nostalgia, or anything that doesn't belong in a formal email — my DMs are open.
